mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here with me. Imagine starting out on the streets of Harlem and finding yourself right in the middle of the civil rights movement. That's the journey we're about to take together as we dive into the remarkable story woven through The Autobiography of Malcolm X, brought to life by Malcolm X himself and Alex Haley. This isn’t just a story about one man. It’s a powerful exploration of how adversity, injustice, and relentless self-reflection can shape a life—and sometimes, even change the world. As we move through times marked by racial tension and social upheaval, we’ll get to ask those big questions—about identity, power, dignity, and what it really means to transform. Malcolm X’s journey is anything but simple. From childhood trauma to time behind bars, from spiritual awakening to bold political action, every chapter shines a light on conviction, courage, and the push to challenge not just society, but ourselves. Throughout, you’ll find moments of heartbreak, hope, and inspiration—each one inviting us to reflect on what it means to grow, to question, and to seek justice. So, as we step into this story together, get ready to explore what shapes identity, what fuels change, and how one person’s quest for freedom can spark something lasting in all of us. Let’s begin this journey.
